title: /reload returns {reloaded:true} without reloading anything
description: Both reader/src/admin.rs:146 and transit/src/admin.rs:388 return {"reloaded":true} unconditionally. No config file is re-read, no state is updated. stoa-ctl reload prints 'Reloaded.' An operator who edits config and calls reload to apply it will get silent non-action. This will generate support reports. Either wire up actual reload (SIGHUP + config re-read) or return 501 Not Implemented so the operator knows to restart the daemon.
